changeinfo.changes: New game mode "PlayStation® League" Improved stability in many game areas Fix for grey windshield in cockpit camera for Moto 3 - KTM RC250GP and Moto 3 - Husqvarna FR250GP Fix for Moto 3 - Vazquez helmet texture Fix for Trophy "Milano-Valencia one way!" was not unlocked satisfying the requirements (accumulate a total of 1335 Km - 830 mi ridden in any game mode) Fix for grey windshield in 3rd person camera for Moto 3 - KTM RC 250 GP Improved graphic LOD management Fix for riders pose (leaning vs tucked in) when using free camera mode AI riders visible on track when racing in qualifying sessions Fix for rain particles effect Fix for rain effect when light rain weather is selected Fix for a warm up voiceover in French and German languages Fix for dirt and scratches effects on riders Fix for Trophies 'The flying wings!', 'The fastest diapason', 'It was a long time', 'Back from Italy' and 'The Red Baron', now unlocked in any game mode Fix for motorbikes engine audio continuously playing while in free camera mode Umbrellas outside motorhome now have different animations Fixed bike names on leaderboards Various minor fixes
Added support for additional content "MotoGP™15 GP de Portugal Circuito Estoril". Fix for crash on Twin Ring Motegi track (wet weather).
